name: Curse of Slippery Steps

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
You curse the target with perpetually poor footing and wet boots. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

---
Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target treats all terrain as difficult terrain for 1 round.

Failure The target treats all terrain as difficult terrain, and it leaves a trail of water behind it, giving any skill checks to Track it during the duration a +2 circumstance bonus. The duration is 1 hour.

Critical Failure As failure, except the duration is 24 hours.
